propositions: verify_completion(ref='HEAD') and subsequent head_sha() read HEAD independently, allowing concurrent commits to split verification and signing phases
a commit landing between verify and sign causes the attestation to be refused but the ticket closes anyway without a completion signature, leaving it permanently unsigned
the suggested recovery ('re-close to certify') is a no-op because the ticket is already closed; only --force-close or manual manifest fabrication work
the non-default --ref path is coherent (80af fix) but the default (no --ref) path still reads HEAD twice and remains vulnerable to TOCTOU
the verified revision should either be pinned for the whole verify+sign+close unit, or the close should abort and leave the ticket in_progress (retryable)
there is no first-class non-force recovery mechanism to obtain a completion attestation for an already-closed-but-unsigned ticket
